entries.name: DARE3d_data_160226/Neural_tube_160226/segmentation3d_new_set_og/runs/12-01-26/.hydra/config.yaml
entries.genuine_archived_text:
task_name: segmentation3d_new_set_og
tags:
- baseline
- unet
train: true
test: true
ckpt_path: null
seed: 12345
train_dir: 3d/new_set_og/train
val_dir: 3d/new_set_og/val
test_dir: 3d/new_set_og/val
steps_per_epoch: 1000
find_lr: false
date: 12-01-26
paths:
  root_dir: ${oc.env:PROJECT_ROOT}
  data_dir: ${paths.root_dir}/data/
  log_dir: ${paths.root_dir}/logs/
  output_dir: ${hydra:runtime.output_dir}
  work_dir: ${hydra:runtime.cwd}
model:
  _target_: dare3d.models.segmentation_module.SegmentationLitModule
  compile: false
  scheduler_interval: step
  net:
    _target_: dare3d.models.components.multiscale_unet.MultiScaleUNet
    spatial_dims: 3
    in_channels: 3
    out_channels: 1
    channels:
    - 32
    - 64
    - 128
    - 256
    - 512
    - 1024
    strides:
    - 2
    - 2
    - 2
    - 2
    - 2
    norm: batch
    num_res_units: 3
    bias: false
    dropout: 0
    downsample_factors: ${downsample_factors}
    output_names:
    - model.1.submodule.2
    - model.1.submodule.1.submodule.2
  criterion:
    _target_: monai.losses.GeneralizedDiceFocalLoss
    include_background: true
    to_onehot_y: false
    sigmoid: true
    reduction: none
  optimizer:
    _target_: torch.optim.AdamW
    _partial_: true
    lr: 0.1
    betas:
    - 0.9
    - 0.999
    weight_decay: 0.0001
  scheduler:
    _target_: torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR
    _partial_: true
    max_lr: ${model.optimizer.lr}
    steps_per_epoch: ${eval:'exec("import numpy as np") or int(np.ceil(${steps_per_epoch}/(${data.batch_size}*${trainer.accumulate_grad_batches})))'}
    epochs: ${trainer.max_epochs}
    pct_start: 0.1
data:
  train_data:
    _target_: dare3d.data.components.seg_3dataset.Segmentation3Dataset
    im_folder: ${paths.data_dir}/${train_dir}/im
    label_folder: ${paths.data_dir}/${train_dir}/label
    sparse_folder: ${paths.data_dir}/${train_dir}/weights
    input_channels: ${input_channels}
    scale_file: ${scale_file}
    default_scale: ${default_scale}
    target_scale: ${target_scale}
    renorm: ${renorm}
    order_dim_img: ${order_dim_img}
    crop_size: ${crop_size}
    type_mask: ${type_mask}
    mask_geom: ${mask_geom}
    radius: ${cell_radius}
    training: true
    steps_per_epoch: ${steps_per_epoch}
    load_labels: true
    downsample_factors: ${downsample_factors}
    time_axis_padding: ${time_axis_padding}
  val_data:
    _target_: dare3d.data.components.seg_3dataset.Segmentation3Dataset
    im_folder: ${paths.data_dir}/${val_dir}/im
    label_folder: ${paths.data_dir}/${val_dir}/label
    sparse_folder: null
    input_channels: ${input_channels}
    scale_file: ${scale_file}
    default_scale: ${default_scale}
    target_scale: ${target_scale}
    renorm: ${renorm}
    order_dim_img: ${order_dim_img}
    crop_size: ${crop_size}
    type_mask: ${type_mask}
    mask_geom: ${mask_geom}
    radius: ${cell_radius}
    training: false
    steps_per_epoch: ${steps_per_epoch}
    load_labels: true
    downsample_factors: ${downsample_factors}
    time_axis_padding: ${time_axis_padding}
  test_data:
    _target_: dare3d.data.components.seg_3dataset.Segmentation3Dataset
    im_folder: ${paths.data_dir}/${test_dir}/im
    label_folder: ${paths.data_dir}/${test_dir}/label
    sparse_folder: null
    input_channels: ${input_channels}
    scale_file: ${scale_file}
    default_scale: ${default_scale}
    target_scale: ${target_scale}
    renorm: ${renorm}
    order_dim_img: ${order_dim_img}
    crop_size: ${crop_size}
    type_mask: ${type_mask}
    mask_geom: ${mask_geom}
    radius: ${cell_radius}
    training: false
    steps_per_epoch: ${steps_per_epoch}
    load_labels: true
    downsample_factors: ${downsample_factors}
    time_axis_padding: ${time_axis_padding}
  augmentation:
    components:
      flip:
        _target_: dare3d.data.gpu_augmentations.MonaiAugmentationComponent
        transform:
          _target_: monai.transforms.RandFlipd
          keys:
          - image
          - label
          - weight
          allow_missing_keys: true
          prob: 0.5
      random_rotate:
        _target_: dare3d.data.gpu_augmentations.MonaiAugmentationComponent
        transform:
          _target_: monai.transforms.RandRotated
          keys:
          - image
          - label
          - weight
          mode:
          - bilinear
          - nearest
          - nearest
          padding_mode:
          - zeros
          - zeros
          - zeros
          allow_missing_keys: true
          range_x: 3.14
          range_y: 3.14
          range_z: 3.14
          prob: 0.5
          keep_size: true
      random_scale:
        _target_: dare3d.data.gpu_augmentations.MonaiAugmentationComponent
        transform:
          _target_: monai.transforms.RandZoomd
          keys:
          - image
          - label
          - weight
          mode:
          - bilinear
          - nearest
          - nearest
          allow_missing_keys: true
          prob: 0.5
          min_zoom: 0.9
          max_zoom: 1.1
          keep_size: true
          lazy: false
      adjust_contrast:
        _target_: dare3d.data.gpu_augmentations.MonaiAugmentationComponent
        transform:
          _target_: monai.transforms.RandAdjustContrastd
          keys:
          - image
          allow_missing_keys: true
          prob: 0.5
          gamma:
          - 0.5
          - 2.5
          retain_stats: true
      histogram_shift:
        _target_: dare3d.data.gpu_augmentations.MonaiAugmentationComponent
        transform:
          _target_: monai.transforms.RandHistogramShiftd
          keys:
          - image
          allow_missing_keys: true
          prob: 0.5
          num_control_points: 3
    _target_: dare3d.data.gpu_augmentations.MonaiAugmentationWrapper
    prob: 0.5
  _target_: dare3d.data.dare_datamodule.DareDataModule
  batch_size: 32
  num_workers: 0
  pin_memory: false
callbacks:
  model_checkpoint:
    _target_: lightning.pytorch.callbacks.ModelCheckpoint
    dirpath: ${paths.output_dir}/checkpoints
    filename: epoch_{epoch:03d}
    monitor: ${monitor_val}
    verbose: false
    save_last: true
    save_top_k: 1
    mode: ${monitor_direction}
    auto_insert_metric_name: false
    save_weights_only: false
    every_n_train_steps: null
    train_time_interval: null
    every_n_epochs: null
    save_on_train_epoch_end: null
  model_summary:
    _target_: lightning.pytorch.callbacks.RichModelSummary
    max_depth: -1
  rich_progress_bar:
    _target_: lightning.pytorch.callbacks.RichProgressBar
logger:
  mlflow:
    _target_: lightning.pytorch.loggers.mlflow.MLFlowLogger
    experiment_name: ${task_name}
    tracking_uri: file:///C:/Users/tlili/Documents/DARE3d/logs/mlflow/mlruns
    tags: null
    prefix: ''
    artifact_location: null
  tensorboard:
    _target_: lightning.pytorch.loggers.tensorboard.TensorBoardLogger
    save_dir: ${paths.output_dir}/tensorboard/
    name: null
    log_graph: false
    default_hp_metric: true
    prefix: ''
  segmentation:
    _target_: dare3d.loggers.segmentation_logger.SegmentationLogger
    save_dir: ${paths.output_dir}/segmentation/
    log_freq: 5
trainer:
  _target_: lightning.pytorch.trainer.Trainer
  default_root_dir: ${paths.output_dir}
  min_epochs: 10
  max_epochs: 200
  accelerator: gpu
  devices: 1
  precision: 32
  log_every_n_steps: 5
  check_val_every_n_epoch: 1
  deterministic: false
  accumulate_grad_batches: 1
  detect_anomaly: false
extras:
  ignore_warnings: false
  enforce_tags: true
  print_config: true
input_channels:
- -1
- 0
- 1
scale_file: ${paths.data_dir}/3d/scales.json
default_scale:
- 0.621
- 0.621
- 2
target_scale: 1.0
renorm: min-max
order_dim_img: zyx
crop_size: 128
type_mask: center
mask_geom: sphere
downsample_factors:
- 1
cell_radius: 8
time_axis_padding: 1
monitor_val: val/iou
monitor_direction: max
